tests.prompt: How long will it take to receive my refund after I return an item?
tests.expected: The assistant explains that refunds are issued to the original payment method after the return is received and inspected, and that this typically takes 3–10 business days depending on the bank or payment provider. It must not invent a guaranteed timeframe.

tests.prompt: I found a checkout bug. The checkout page crashes after I click Place Order, instead of completing the order. To reproduce it: open the checkout page, enter valid payment details, and click Place Order. Environment: Ubuntu 24.04 on a desktop PC using Firefox 132. Please submit this bug report.
tests.expected: The assistant submits the report using the bug-report tool only after receiving the description, reproduction steps, and environment. It confirms submission only if the tool succeeds and provides the actual ticket identifier returned by the tool.

tests.prompt: Please look up my order and tell me whether the payment has cleared. My order number is DEMO-12345.
tests.expected: The assistant explains that it cannot access order or payment records and directs the customer to the site's help/contact form or an order email. It must not claim to have looked up the order or invent payment status.
